summary: In a military barracks, Captain Cable meets Ray, who has been told to stack some soldiers' gear and return it. Cable assures Ray that the soldiers will soon be begging him to take their belongings back, and then leads Ray through the barracks to find Kilgore and Rodriguez. The passage describes the crowded sleeping cubicles, the soldiers' personal keepsakes, and a playful, tense exchange in which Kilgore throws a football at Rodriguez and both men snap to attention when the officers arrive.
one_line: Captain Cable leads Ray through a crowded barracks to find soldiers Kilgore and Rodriguez, who are nervously tossing a football.
key_facts: Captain Cable speaks to Ray about stacking soldiers' gear and returning it as soon as possible.
Ray apologizes to Cable for the inconvenience, and Cable replies that Ray will soon be begging him to take the gear back.
Cable says that by the time it is all over, the soldiers will be the ones doing the begging.
Cable says the soldiers' mates were assigned to pull head polish duty, cleaning the latrine, that morning.
Cable suspects Kilgore and Rodriguez are getting nervous because they were not on latrine duty.
The barracks is a long, low-ceilinged chamber divided into rows of sleeping cubicles stacked three berths tall.
Ray compares the cubicles to sleeping compartments on passenger trains, with a dark curtain for privacy.
The cubicles are decorated with pictures, letters written in children's handwriting, and fading centerfolds.
Kilgore and Rodriguez are tossing a football in low, tight spirals down the length of the aisle when Cable and Ray arrive.
Rodriguez stands at attention and catches Kilgore's last throw in the middle of his gut without flinching.
Kilgore says 'Good hands, assclown' to Rodriguez.
Rodriguez responds 'Officer on the deck' with only a slight hint of strain in his voice.
Cable tells Ray that the soldiers are on their best behavior and that it is all downhill from here.
Kilgore snaps a regulation salute to Captain Cable and begins to apologize to the Deck Officer.
